Hi Christine —

Received, thanks. A few quick clarifying asks so we can create the vendor master cleanly in our ERP: 

1) Legal name formatting — please confirm how you want the "Legal name" field entered. Is "Ventra Supplies, Inc." the exact name to appear on contracts and invoices (including punctuation)?
2) Tax form — W‑9 is perfect for US entity. Can you confirm the signing authority name on the W‑9 and whether the EIN above is correct?
3) Remit address — we have a separate remit/ACH address in our system. Is the Harbor Way address used for mailed checks only? If you accept ACH, please advise whether the bank details will be provided via secure portal (we prefer a bank letter or completed ACH form).
4) PO & invoicing — what email should Redwood route POs to? You mentioned vendor@ventra-supplies.com; please confirm inbox ownership and if Tom should be CC’d on PO confirmations.

Operational notes: our procurement flow will create a payee record and then route to Finance (cc: Dev) to approve payment terms and set up ACH. If everything checks, we’ll create the payee and raise the first PO. It’s helpful if you attach a copy of a recent invoice with the remit block visible — speeds setup.

If you can reply with the signed W‑9 and the vendor master form filled, we should be able to finish this today and have a payee record created by tomorrow.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
